dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Cowboys (5-6) Week 12 Briefing: Friday Injury Report Ahead of Eagles
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Dallas opened CB Devin Moore's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for S P.J. Locke (concussion). TE Jake Ferguson (knee / ankle), G Tyler Booker (ankle), and WR Jonathan Mingo (ankle) did not practice Friday, while CB Devin Moore (hip) and S Jalen Thompson (hamstring) practiced in full [Patrik Walker](https://x.com/VoiceOfTheStar/status/2125665032646091241).

Week 12 Eagles Outlook: Brian Schottenheimer and DC Christian Parker open installation for the Philadelphia Eagles (3-7, DAL -8.5, HC Nick Sirianni, OC Sean Mannion & DC Vic Fangio (AT&T Stadium))—a unit ranked #5 in Punt Return Average (12.0 yds) as Dallas prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [LP Cruz](https://www.bloggingtheboys.com/dallas-cowboys-injuries/228198/injury-report-jalen-thompson-questionable) [Patrik Walker](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4242355/jake-ferguson#:~:text=The%20Cowboys%20ruled%20Ferguson%20%28knee%2Fankle%29%20out%20for).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 5-6 (2nd in NFC East • #10 Seed in NFC), Dallas carries a 15.3% postseason projection, 14.2% NFC East division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Mike Poland](https://www.bloggingtheboys.com/dallas-cowboys-discussion/228026/discussion-eagles-playoffs-nfc-east-wild-card-giants-thanksgiving).
